source: With {0}, every key is literal: {1}, {2} and {3} are each one key, a new key is one property of the file, and no key is the parent of another. A resource pattern can set its own {4}, for example {5} on {6} while PHP files keep {7}. The {8}, {9}, {10} and {11} presets set literal keys where their libraries use them.
text: 設為 {0} 時，每個鍵都是字面值：{1}、{2} 和 {3} 各自是一個鍵，新的鍵是檔案的一個屬性，且沒有任何鍵是另一個鍵的父層。資源模式可以設定自己的 {4}，例如在 {6} 上使用 {5}，而 PHP 檔案維持 {7}。{8}、{9}、{10} 和 {11} 預設集會在其函式庫使用字面鍵的地方設定字面鍵。
